article.headline: Noah Williamson scores 25 to help Bucknell rally for 73-69 victory over Navy
article.description: — Noah Williamson scored 25 points and Bucknell rallied for a 73-69 victory over Navy on Saturday.
article.linkText: Noah Williamson scores 25 to help Bucknell rally for 73-69 victory over Navy
article.story: LEWISBURG, Pa. -- — Noah Williamson scored 25 points and Bucknell rallied for a 73-69 victory over Navy on Saturday. Williamson also grabbed eight rebounds for the Bison (8-11, 4-2 Patriot League). Josh Bascoe scored 18 points and added seven assists and three steals. Ruot Bijiek had nine points. Austin Benigni led the way for the Midshipmen (5-14, 2-4) with 23 points, five assists and two steals. Jinwoo Kim had 13 points. Aidan Kehoe contributed nine points, 11 rebounds and two steals. Bucknell went into halftime trailing 36-27. Williamson scored 18 points in the second half to lead the Bucknell rally. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
